summary: Frontend-only E2E of the NEW Mystery Shops 'Demo shop' feature + per-client 'Text people their scorecard' toggle + public /shop-score/<token> page. All 10 mandatory checks pass on preview. Backend validation curls both pass (400 for bad phone, 4 service challenges). No product bugs found. Demo call correctly places a Twilio call to a 500-555 test number without crashing; duplicate-phone flow correctly surfaces 409 'is already on a shop call' (documented alternative to upsert). Public scorecard renders score-hero/ring/title/meta/summary/wins/fixes/coaching with all expected copy; invalid token shows score-error. Admin call detail exposes shop-call-score-link + shop-call-sms-status 'Scorecard texted to Sam · opened 3x' and shop-call-score-copy toasts 'Scorecard link copied'. ClientSheet has client-text-scorecards-toggle; toggling ON, saving, reloading, re-toggling OFF all work and are persisted (verified via GET /api/shop-clients/{id}). Cleanup done: QA Demo Rep person deleted from Demo shops via DELETE /api/shop-clients/people/6aa60b532366ce57ee4698c8 (200); Demo Dan preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: DemoShopSheet correctly disables demo-call and swaps copy to 'Name and cell number first' / 'Call <First> now' based on name>=2 chars + 10-digit phone; matches spec.

GET /api/shop-clients/{cid} returns nested {client: {...}} with `people` as an int count when accessed at top level in some paths (verified: people: 1 for Demo shops). Not a bug — this endpoint appears to return summary shape; the client detail page loads full people list from a separate endpoint. Just document for future testers.
Duplicate-phone flow while a demo call is still dialing correctly rejects with 409 'X is already on a shop call' rather than silently upserting — matches spec's alternate-accepted behavior.
Public /shop-score/<token> renders all expected copy including must-have flag + italic evidence quote. Invalid token shows 'This scorecard link is not valid.' — matches spec.
